Develops, plans, and drafts various department documents, reports, programs related material.
Responds to and resolves issues and inquiries from the public and participates in public meetings as required.
Performs other duties as assigned.

Experience with a variety of indoor and outdoor recreational activities and comprehensive event planning.
Customer Service and excellent communication skills (written and verbal)Use of modern office equipment, computers, electronic devices, and various programs and applications, including Microsoft Word, Excel, SharePoint, and Parks and Recreation Software.
Supervision and training principles and practices as it pertains to youth, active adults, and/or senior specific programs.
